text: Yes, trees were cut down on this property after 2020. The analysis shows that while 0.4 hectares had tree cover in 2000 (>=30% canopy), no forest was present in 2020 according to the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset. Given the corroboration rule and the absence of forest in 2020, it is clear that tree cover was removed after 2020. The evidence meets the criteria for deforestation, as the tree cover loss is confirmed by the reference data.
